opening.argument: The video presents a referral-based business in which using a referral link means intending to build a team, and referred members are encouraged to build teams of their own. It gives that recruitment structure a concrete money-flow mechanism: referrers are told to identify members who have joined but not funded their accounts, ask about Bitcoin, and assist them with funding. The presentation also displays a branching member diagram labeled with referral and genealogy structures, while describing the business as a vehicle to financial freedom. Referrers are further told they can find members' email addresses and mobile numbers. Although no specific guaranteed return is stated, the records do not establish actual returns, losses, consent to contact, or completed transactions.
